name: Yin Release Adept: Yin Release – Uncertain Future

system.description: You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to obfuscate the assumptions and plans they just had, blinding them to their own desires. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, and they cast a jutsu or spends their Action, Bonus Action or Reaction while within 60 feet of a Kuru that can see them, that Kuru can spend their Reaction and spend 2 Foresight, forcing the Yin-Sealed creature to make a Charisma saving throw vs the Kuru’s highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, the Yin-Sealed creature must perform an alternative Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or Jutsu with the same casting time, or they lose the Action they spent as the ability to perform that action is temporarily sealed.
